entries.label: MGS1 — Supply Route / tunnel de fuite
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE empty 2D fighting-game stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, wide landscape 16:9. This is an accurate painted-HD adaptation of Metal Gear Solid 1 (1998 PlayStation original), NOT the Twin Snakes remake. Inspect and follow the attached original-game reference for architecture, colors, materials and identifying layout. Remove all people, vehicles, HUD, text, logos, annotation arrows and map markers. No collage, no labels, no watermark. Keep a continuous horizontal combat floor across the lower quarter and a coherent readable background. No fake layer split, no spritesheet, no UI. Preserve the reference's distinctive shapes rather than replacing the location with a generic military room. LOCATION the jeep escape tunnel after REX, original Metal Gear Solid. Reproduce the reference's very utilitarian rectangular underground road tunnel: dull tan-brown stained concrete panel walls, horizontal protective rails at waist height, warm round wall lamps spaced evenly, low flat industrial ceiling with dark rectangular ventilation grilles, concrete road surface with a single broken white center line. Show a wide side-on road segment as the horizontal fighting lane, with the tunnel depth and checkpoint opening receding slightly behind. Reference-only architecture, not a futuristic arched subway or brightly modern highway. Low amber light, grainy worn military service tunnel materials, empty of jeeps, people, barriers in the front lane, weapons, HUD and lettering.

notes: Identity, original edition, palette and defining structures checked against the listed game screenshots.
Wide painted combat view includes composition and hidden-detail adaptation; strict 1:1 certification remains pending.
Static source only; not admitted to runtime, no animated layers or collision geometry.
